```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Composite scores combine multiple concept evaluations into a single numeric score
per object instance.

## Setup

```{r}
library(conceptR)
library(duckdb)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb(), ":memory:")

bundle <- ontologySpecR::bundle(
  bundle_id      = "scores-vignette",
  bundle_version = "0.1.0",
  objects = list(
    ontologySpecR::object_type(
      id           = "Patient",
      properties   = list(
        list(id = "patient_id", type = "text"),
        list(id = "age", type = "integer"),
        list(id = "comorbidities", type = "integer"),
        list(id = "readmission_risk", type = "integer")
      ),
      primary_key  = "patient_id",
      source_kind  = "table",
      source_table = "patients"
    )
  )
)

DBI::dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE patients (
    patient_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    age             INTEGER,
    comorbidities   INTEGER,
    readmission_risk INTEGER
  )
")

set.seed(7)
for (i in 1:25) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con,
    "INSERT INTO patients VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
    params = list(paste0("PT", i),
                  sample(30:85, 1), sample(0:5, 1), sample(0:1, 1)))
}

ctx <- concept_context(bundle, con)
```

## Define component concepts

```{r}
cpt_define(ctx, "elderly",           "Patient")
cpt_define(ctx, "multimorbid",       "Patient")
cpt_define(ctx, "readmission_risk",  "Patient")

cpt_add_version(ctx, "elderly",          "clinical", "age > 65",              status = "active")
cpt_add_version(ctx, "multimorbid",      "clinical", "comorbidities > 2",     status = "active")
cpt_add_version(ctx, "readmission_risk", "clinical", "readmission_risk = 1",  status = "active")
```

## Define a weighted composite score

```{r}
cpt_define_score(ctx, "frailty_index", "Patient",
  components = list(
    list(concept_id = "elderly",          scope = "clinical", version = 1L, weight = 1.0),
    list(concept_id = "multimorbid",      scope = "clinical", version = 1L, weight = 2.0),
    list(concept_id = "readmission_risk", scope = "clinical", version = 1L, weight = 3.0)
  ),
  aggregation = "weighted_sum",
  thresholds  = list(low = 1, medium = 3, high = 5),
  description = "Composite frailty index (0-6)"
)
```

## Evaluate the score

```{r}
results <- cpt_evaluate_score(ctx, "frailty_index")
head(results)
```

## Score distribution

```{r}
dist <- cpt_score_distribution(ctx, "frailty_index")
cat("Min:",    dist$min,    "\n")
cat("Median:", dist$median, "\n")
cat("Max:",    dist$max,    "\n")
print(dist$tier_counts)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
